text: True or False: Heterodyne (dual-homodyne) detection measures both quadratures x and p simultaneously at no cost in added noise.
explanation: False — simultaneously measuring the conjugate observables x and p forces a mandatory penalty of one added vacuum unit per quadrature, the price for reading both at once. Only single-quadrature homodyne detection avoids this added noise, selecting the measured quadrature via the local-oscillator phase.
